name: HIRO Industries
long_description: HIRO Industries builds affordable, easy-to-use robots for real work. Our first robot, Origin, is a two-armed robot designed for tasks like sorting, packing, kitting, and assembly. We combine teleoperation with AI to help robots perform useful work today while collecting data to improve their autonomy over time. Our longer-term goal is to build an American robotics platform that makes capable robots accessible to more businesses and developers.
one_liner: We’re building an American robotics platform, starting with Origin,…

founders.title: Founder/CEO
founders.founder_bio: I’m the cofounder and CEO of HIRO Industries. Ethan and I built our first robot, Origin, in six weeks in a garage. It has two arms and costs $9,950. We’re building it for tasks like packing boxes and unloading 3D printers. Before HIRO, I was a founding engineer at Nori Robotics (YC S26) and built two autonomous cleaning robots for Hampton Lumber. If your team packs products by hand or uses robots on a factory floor, I’d love to hear what that looks like.

founders.title: Founder/CTO
founders.founder_bio: Founder/CTO at HIRO Industries. Previously founded Vcrypt Financial, building high-performance algorithmic trading software and leading a team of 9. Developed firmware for prosthetics at BIOMOTUM, drastically improving speed, range, and reliability. MS in Robotics and BS in Electrical Engineering from Oregon State.
